name: Gard
shape: Eurostat NUTS, the area it is named for

climate: Grenache, Syrah, Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A departmental PGI covering the whole Gard vineyard, where Grenache covers about 27% of the area and Syrah 20%. It was called vin de pays du Gard until 2009.
